# Kokoroou

> Personal CV site of Tuấn Anh Trương, a DevOps engineer focused on AI infrastructure (Kubernetes, GPU platforms, LLM serving). Previously an AI engineer.

## Pages

- [CV](https://kokoroou.github.io/): profile, expertise, selected work and experience.

## Projects

- [MakerLens — RPG Maker Asset Viewer](https://kokoroou.github.io/rpgmaker-assets-viewer/): free, browser-based viewer and extractor for RPG Maker MV, MZ, XP, VX and VX Ace assets. Runs 100% client-side. Details: [llms.txt](https://kokoroou.github.io/rpgmaker-assets-viewer/llms.txt)
